regions.today: Mostly dry for the rest of the day with sunny spells and the odd isolated showers, in light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tonight: Dry and partly cloudy tonight. Some mist patches will develop locally. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees with light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be generally dry with a mix of cloud and sunny spells. It'll become breezy again with a moderate to fresh southerly wind, strengthening up along the southern coast. Highest temperatures of 13 or 14 degrees.
